messages:
ana (PM): Quick sync—need to lock streaming semantic tradeoffs for chat/completions by EOD Friday. Customers pushing for resume+function-call streaming. Proposing SSE primary + WS optional. Thoughts?

sam (Eng Runtime): SSE is simpler for proxies and mobile, lower connection headroom. But resume semantics + multiplexing are trickier. WS easier for bidir but heavier on infra.

mira (Eng Platform): Enterprise customers want guaranteed resume tokens and audit traces. If SSE we need a resume token in every chunk that's stable across model variants.

lee (Product Manager): Priorities: 1) reliable resume, 2) function-call streaming (partial args), 3) minimal SDK churn. Any approach that breaks current SDKs is lower priority.

jordan (Solutions): A large customer will accept WS if it means resume with at-most-once semantics. They run through enterprise proxies though.

olivia (Eng SDK): SDK cost: SSE maps well to EventSource in browsers and RN. WS requires additional connection management in RN and more QA. We can wrap WS but more work.

sam (Eng Runtime): Proposal A: SSE delta events with fields {chunk_id, resume_cursor, role, token, finish_reason?}. Resume cursor = monotonic per-session offset. Fallback: server stores last N cursors.

ana (PM): Example SSE event? Can you paste a sample payload we can vet with customers?

sam (Eng Runtime): ```
event: delta
data: {"chunk_id":"c_42","resume_cursor":"s-0000123","role":"assistant","delta":"Thanks","function_call":null}

event: finish
data: {"finish_reason":"stop","cursor":"s-0000123"}
```

mira (Eng Platform): If cursor state is server-managed, Private deployments need clear retention and KMS controls. Also cost of storing per-request cursors could grow. Suggest TTL + optional external storage for customers.

lee (Product Manager): Launch gates: - resume correctness on 99.9% of happy paths - mobile SDKs using EventSource without degradation - function-call streamable end-to-end (partial args) - rollout plan with canary + automatic fallback to poll mode.

jordan (Solutions): Can we make resume optional per-route? Some customers want it, others don't. Plus add a max-retry count in protocol.

olivia (Eng SDK): Agree per-route toggle simplifies SDK. We can default off for new routes and opt-in.

sam (Eng Runtime): On finish reasons: enumerate {stop, length, cancelled, error, function_returning}. We should stream partial finish when function_call is in-flight: finish_reason="function_call_pending" then final "function_returning" when done.

ana (PM): Customer ask: streaming structured JSON chunks (structured output) while streaming tokens. Is the plan to send structured deltas OR annotate tokens with schema hints?

olivia (Eng SDK): Prefer structured deltas as separate event types: `structured` events carrying JSON patches. That avoids token-splitting ambiguity.

mira (Eng Platform): Operational notes: handshake must advertise supported events (delta, structured, finish, resume). If client requests an unsupported event, server responds with a 422 and suggests fallback.

sam (Eng Runtime): Backpressure: SSE lacks built-in binary control; we'll include `X-Flow-Control` header and a `watermark` field in events. For heavy mobile apps we can recommend chunk_size limits.

ana (PM): OK next steps: 1) draft protocol doc with examples + SDK notes (assigned to olivia) 2) implement resume token prototype in runtime (sam) 3) platform storage TTL options and enterprise config (mira) 4) customer validation with Jordan's pilot customer (jordan). Aim: PR for spec by Wed.

olivia (Eng SDK): I'll start SDK PR and a migration guide.

jordan (Solutions): I'll get pilot sign-off and test resume across proxies.

deploy-bot: canary: streaming-resume-sse deployed to staging at 1749890450 :rocket:

ana (PM): Thanks all — if no objections I'll lock on SSE-first, WS opt-in, per-route resume toggle, structured-event type, and the finish_reason enum. Raise objections now or we'll proceed.

sam (Eng Runtime): No objections from me. Will spike WS fallback later.

mira (Eng Platform): No objections. I'll add enterprise storage policy to the spec.

lee (Product Manager): 👍 let's move forward.
